newsitem.title: USA: Amax, Bema gold mine operational.
newsitem.headline: Amax, Bema gold mine operational.

text.p: Amax Gold Inc and Bema Gold Corp said Friday that their jointly owned Refugio gold mine in Chile went into commercial production on October 1.
The companies said that all of the mine's crushers were operating and have surpassed design capacity rates of 30,000 tons of half-inch ore per day.
They also said that the mechanical and structural problems at the fine crushing plant, including collapse of the constructed fill under a storage bin, have been resolved.
More than 5.5 million tons have now been placed on the leach pads, and about 64,000 ounces of gold have been recovered since the first gold pour in mid-April.
The mine is expected to produce an average of 233,000 ounces of gold per year with average cash operating costs of $235 per ounce.
